cues.text: You answered my urgent midnight summons to the Royal Observatory —
yet as you arrive, I am already gone.
The Great Conjunction passes at the stroke of twelve.
Someone else seeks what I have hidden here,
so I sealed the ironbound Astrolabe Door behind you, and scattered the key across my instruments.
Begin at my writing desk, beneath the emerald lamp.
Follow my logbook through the Lunar Cryptex, the Great Telescope, and the Celestial Orrery.
Recover the Obsidian Star Key, and unseal the chamber before midnight.
